answer.label: Bourdain credit unsupported
answer.sourceLine: Truth or Fiction found no credible original Bourdain source and located the passage in a June 2021 forum tribute. A July 2021 Newcity review also repeats it as Bourdain’s, without an original reference. These later appearances establish circulation, not authorship; no verified creator has been identified.
